content: Credit freemium practices (billing-vendor guidance, opinion-grade): always-visible balance and reset date, low-balance warnings before zero, cost shown before the action, contextual upgrade prompt at the moment of need, one-click top-up, no dark patterns (countdowns, stacked discounts). Referral rewards: product-denominated two-sided rewards (Dropbox storage model), reward on a meaningful activation event, one referrer per recipient, reject self-referrals. No conversion data found for monthly reset vs one-time grant.
